preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix A is between 1 and 250, inclusive.
The number of columns in the matrix A is between 1 and 250, inclusive.
The destination row index X is within the bounds of the matrix.
The destination column index Y is within the bounds of the matrix.
The values in the matrix A are either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of steps required to reach (X, Y) from (0,0), or -1 if it is impossible.
